title: BlackX UEFI Bootkit Targets Central Asian Diplomats
excerpt: A new UEFI bootkit named BlackX targets diplomatic organizations in Central Asia, bypassing Secure Boot on patched Windows systems.
body_html:
A sophisticated Unified Extensible Firmware Interface bootkit known as BlackX has been deployed in targeted attacks against diplomatic organizations in Central Asia. According to a technical report by Kaspersky, the campaign took place in early 2026 and focused on entities located in Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, and Turkmenistan.

The malicious software is capable of bypassing Secure Boot on patched Windows systems that are missing necessary revocations. Security researchers suspect that the cyber espionage activity is orchestrated by APT41, a state-sponsored hacking group with links to China.
